summary: Rezolve AI plc (NASDAQ: RZLV) filed a Form 6-K on June 30, 2026, announcing shareholder approval at its AGM of a capital reduction and authority to launch a share repurchase program of up to $300 million. The buyback, subject to UK Court approval, aims to address a perceived disconnect between public market valuation and hyper-growth trajectory; no price per share or premium was specified. Q1 2026 unaudited revenue was ~$60M, with FY26 guidance of ~$360M. The board has flexibility to execute repurchases opportunistically. Monitor UK Court timeline and actual buyback initiation for signal of value return.
